sources.title: Contents of each SuperCluster Quarterly Full Stack Download Patch (QFSDP)
Oracle SuperCluster M8 and M7 Configuration Guide

notes: Imported lines and versions are associated Database release levels, not SuperCluster hardware or image versions.
Only explicit SuperCluster QFSDP labels are admitted. Oracle announcements corroborate named package identities only.
The saved source does not establish the current latest SuperCluster QFSDP or every model and platform applicability.
KB117594 records QFSDP bundles independently of the associated Database release observations. For its full-stack rows, artifact scope lists the model labels in the Platform Firmware column.
QFSDP names preserve Oracle's quarter or month label. Only explicitly stated release or reissue dates appear on KB117594 package observations.
Q3 2018 update patch 28183380 replaced patch 28183354. Both are retained. Q2 2019 patch 29252451 was released in August 2019 and replaces the Q3 2019 QFSDP.
KB117594 identifies Q1 2026 patch 38658593 as the final SuperCluster QFSDP. Hardware support end dates are addressed separately in PNEWS2744.
The current MOS capture of KB117594 displays Legacy Doc ID 1569461.1. Older Oracle documentation cites the same table title under Doc ID 2056975.1.

For KB117594 full-stack records, artifact corroboration identifies the proactive MOS notes that explicitly list a release date for the exact QFSDP patch number. Oracle's dates in those notes do not establish download availability.
The proactive notes give 2018-07-17 for both the original and replacement Q3 2018 packages. The replacement package 28183380 retains an unresolved reissue date.
